intro: Edgewood Treatment Centre offers a wide range of programs that cater to the diverse needs of their patients. These programs are designed to provide comprehensive care and support to individuals struggling with addiction, trauma, and psychological injury. They understand that every patient is unique, which is why they offer a personalized approach to each program that they offer.

Edgewood’s detox program provides medically supervised services for patients who are experiencing physical withdrawal symptoms associated with substance abuse. They have licensed medical professionals who are available 24/7 to ensure the patient’s comfort and safety throughout the detoxification process. Their detox program provides a stable and supportive environment and provides patients with the first step towards a successful recovery.

Edgewood’s inpatient program provides intensive residential treatment for individuals struggling with addiction and mental health issues. Their inpatient care programs are designed to provide an immersive experience that fosters healing, growth, and recovery. Their innovative and holistic approach integrates a range of evidence-based therapies, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavioral therapy, and trauma therapy.

pillars.title: A Purpose-Built Centre on Boxwood Road
pillars.body: EHN Edgewood Nanaimo, listed with us for years as Edgewood Treatment Centre, is a 42,000-square-foot licensed treatment centre in Nanaimo, built for addiction care. Patients sleep in standard or semi-private rooms and eat in the Bridges Dining Room, and there is a small café and snack store for coffee between sessions. Outside, stone paths run past gardens, benches and a covered gazebo to walking trails and a labyrinth that staff use for walking meditation. Inside there is a gym, an Indigenous space, an LGBTQ+ friendly space and a multi-faith room.

pillars.title: Extended Care
pillars.body: Edgewood’s extended care program provides ongoing treatment and support for patients transitioning from inpatient care. This program is designed to help patients maintain their sobriety and continue to build positive relationships and connections with others in recovery. Edgewood provides a safe and supportive space that provides patients with resources and community to work through life’s challenges as they continue on their recovery journey.

pillars.title: Family Programs
pillars.body: At Edgewood Treatment Centre, family involvement is a crucial aspect of their treatment programs. Edgewood recognizes that addiction does not only affect the individual but also impacts the family unit as a whole. Their Family Program provides a safe, supportive space for families to learn and understand addiction and ways they can support their loved ones recover in sobriety.

overview: Our network of recovery centres offers top-notch mental health care services catering to our patients’ needs. We cover a wide range of treatment programs, including outpatient therapy, detox stays, and multi-month treatment for individuals with substance use disorders and other mental health conditions. At our rehab centre, we focus on providing personalized, evidence-based care that takes into account each patient’s unique challenges.

Our approach to mental health and substance use disorder treatment is centered on medical excellence and scientific research. We have a team of licensed medical professionals, including psychiatrists, skilled nurses, addiction-certified doctors, and occupational therapists, who are involved in every step of our patients’ recovery journey. Through our licensed hospitals and accredited facilities, we offer a safe, inclusive, and comfortable environment for recovery. Our vision is to promote destigmatized, flexible, and accessible mental health care services with no wait times, accessible nationwide, and on par with treatment for other conditions.

In carrying out our mission, we strive to provide full-spectrum care to achieve positive outcomes, delivered by medical experts motivated by compassion and courage. We are committed to helping our patients tackle the root causes of their concerns through evidence-based care. We aim to support families in the healing process and the public care system at large. Our core values, including exceptional medical care, courage, and compassion, underpin our rehabilitation centre’s culture, and we continue to work towards improving the mental and emotional well-being of all those who seek our services.

afterOverview: Edgewood’s trauma and addiction program is designed to address the complex relationship between trauma and addiction. Their program provides individuals struggling with substance use disorder the opportunity to access specialized trauma-informed care that helps them work through their addiction, regulate their feelings, and improve their overall well-being.

Sex addiction is a complex disorder that is often misunderstood. Edgewood’s Sexual Addiction program provides specialized treatment and care for individuals struggling with sex addiction. Their program offers a safe and confidential environment that focuses on healing, recovery, and understanding about this addiction.

Edgewood’s Trauma and Psychological Injury program is designed to help individuals who have experienced a traumatic experience gain insight and help them understand how their trauma has impacted their lives. Their program provides specialized care to help individuals work through the trauma that often leads to addiction.

Edgewood recognizes that members of the LGBTQ+ community face unique challenges when it comes to seeking addiction treatment. That’s why their programs are designed to be inclusive and sensitive to the unique needs and experiences of this community, by providing a supportive and affirmative environment.

location.heading: EHN Edgewood Nanaimo in Nanaimo, British Columbia
location.intro: EHN Edgewood Nanaimo is on Boxwood Road in central Nanaimo, on the east coast of Vancouver Island and about 10 minutes from the Departure Bay ferry terminal. Coming from Vancouver takes about three hours including the Horseshoe Bay ferry, Victoria is roughly an hour and a half south over the Malahat, and Parksville, Ladysmith and Duncan in the Cowichan Valley are all under an hour by car.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and the EHN Canada website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does EHN Edgewood Nanaimo cost?
faqs.a: EHN Edgewood Nanaimo does not publish its prices. Admissions gives you a quote after a free, confidential assessment confirms a program fits, and the cost depends on program length, clinical complexity and the services you choose. It is a private centre, but many private health plans pay for part of a stay, and the team can help you check your coverage and look at financing.

faqs.q: How long is the inpatient program?
faqs.a: The core drug and alcohol program and the Indigenous program both run about seven weeks. The hybrid option is two weeks in residence followed by eight weeks of online treatment from home. People who need more structure afterwards can move into extended care for at least a month.

faqs.q: Does EHN Edgewood Nanaimo offer detox?
faqs.a: Yes. The centre runs a medically supervised detox and stabilization program, with nurses and physicians managing withdrawal before residential treatment starts. You do not need a doctor's referral, so you or a family member can call admissions directly.

faqs.q: Where is EHN Edgewood Nanaimo and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 2121 Boxwood Road in Nanaimo, on the east coast of Vancouver Island, about 10 minutes from the Departure Bay ferry terminal. From Vancouver it is roughly three hours including the BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay, and from Victoria it is about an hour and a half up the Malahat. Admissions can help plan travel before you arrive.
Yes, many private health insurance plans may cover part of the cost of treatment at Edgewood. However, coverage varies depending on the specific policy and plan.

faqs.q: Does the centre have an Indigenous program?
faqs.a: Yes. The Vancouver Island Indigenous Addiction Recovery Inpatient Program is a seven-week stay that, in the centre's words, combines traditional Indigenous practices with evidence-based addiction treatment. EHN says ceremonies and teachings are often guided by Elders and Knowledge Keepers, and the program introduces the Red Road to Wellbriety teachings. The centre sits on the traditional territory of the Snuneymuxw First Nation.

Every inpatient program includes a year of aftercare, built around a weekly group with other alumni. You also get lifelong membership in the EHN Canada Alumni Association. If you are not ready to go home, extended care in the Ferguson building next to the main centre adds group therapy, self-help meetings and volunteer work each week.

faqs.q: What type of addiction does Edgewood treat?
faqs.a: Edgewood provides treatment for a wide range of addictions, including substance abuse, sex addiction, and gambling addiction.

faqs.q: Can patients receive psychiatric care at Edgewood?
faqs.a: Yes, Edgewood has a team of experienced psychiatrists and mental health professionals who provide comprehensive care and support for patients struggling with various mental health disorders.

faqs.q: Can family members visit patients during their inpatient stay?
faqs.a: Yes, family members are welcome to visit their loved ones during their inpatient stay at Edgewood.

faqs.q: Can patients use their phone and internet while in treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, patients are allowed to use their phone and internet during their treatment. However, there are limitations in place to ensure the patient’s safety and focus on their recovery.

faqs.q: How long do patients have to stay at Edgewood Treatment Centre?
faqs.a: The length of a patient’s stay depends on their individual needs and goals. Some patients may stay for as little as thirty days, while others need longer care.

faqs.q: Can patients access exercise facilities at Edgewood?
faqs.a: Yes, Edgewood has a state-of-the-art gym and fitness center available for their patients. Exercise and physical activity are important components of their comprehensive care approach.

faqs.q: What is the success rate of Edgewood’s programs?
faqs.a: Edgewood’s programs have significant success rates. Patients who engage in their recovery programs have a better chance of achieving and maintaining long-term sobriety.
